## Summary

I have implemented the Fitting Model Try-On Looks feature as specified. Here's a summary of the work completed:

### Work Completed:
- **Extended Type Definitions**: Added `tryOnImageUrl`, `tryOnImageBase64`, and `isGeneratingTryOn` fields to `Outfit` interface in `lib/types.ts`; added `'try-on'` to the `generationType` union in `lib/types/image-types.ts`
- **Created generateTryOnLooks function**: Added `TryOnLooksRequest` interface and implemented `generateTryOnLooks()` function in `fitting-model-service.ts` with:
  - Input validation for fitting model URL and outfit items
  - Prompt builder that creates outfit description from items
  - Image fetching and base64 conversion
  - API call to `/api/generate-image` with try-on generation type
- **Updated API Route**: Modified `app/api/generate-image/route.ts` to:
  - Handle `'try-on'` generation type with reference image validation
  - Route try-on requests to `generateFittingModelImage()` method
  - Apply background removal post-processing for try-on images
- **Updated OutfitRecommendationCard**: Added complete try-on UI with:
  - "ลองใส่" (Try On) button with Shirt icon in action row
  - Modal dialog for displaying try-on image
  - Loading state with spinner and progress text
  - Error handling with retry button
  - Regenerate ("ลองใส่ใหม่") functionality
  - Caching of generated images to avoid regeneration
  - Edge case handling for users without fitting model

### Files Changed & Lines:
```
apps/web/app/api/generate-image/route.ts           | 157 changes (validation + routing)
apps/web/components/chat/OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx | 314 changes (button + modal + state)
apps/web/lib/types.ts                              |  20 changes (new Outfit fields)
apps/web/lib/types/image-types.ts                  |  54 changes (try-on type)
apps/web/lib/services/fitting-model-service.ts     | 363 lines (new file - try-on function)
                                                   --------
Total                                              | ~908 lines added/modified
```
